paper_title: Improved bounds on ultralight scalar dark matter in the radio-frequency range
coupling_convention: g_gamma in eV^-1 (paper's alpha coupling, alpha(t)=alpha_0[1+g_gamma*phi]; multiply by M_Pl=2.4e27 eV for dimensionless d_e)
notes: Paper reports new 95% C.L. exclusion limits from Experiment B (Cs optical spectroscopy, 20 kHz-100 MHz, mass 8e-11 to 4e-7 eV) on both photon coupling g_gamma and electron coupling g_e of scalar UDM; ScalarPhoton chosen per pre-analysis hint. No numerical table is provided; data points are reconstructed from the Fig. 1 delta-f/f constraints (~1e-16 to ~1e-15 for Exp B) via Eq. (5): g_gamma = (delta f/f)/(2.26 * sqrt(2*rho_DM)/m_phi) with rho_DM = 3e-6 eV^4 (~0.4 GeV/cm^3, standard galactic halo scenario). Values are approximate figure-derived estimates, hence moderate extraction confidence. Experiment A results are shown only as ultimate sensitivity (projection), not limits; Solar/Earth-halo panels assume enhanced local density and are not included.
